theorem closeAt_iff
    (hM : MultiplicationExact specConstructors FixedConst.cstar.value FixedConst.ell.value T)
    (N K : Fin 5 → ℚ) (t : ℚ) :
    CloseAt T N K t ↔
      ∃ n κ a l : ℤ, N = iota n ∧ K = iota κ ∧
        accepts ![enc n, enc κ, enc a, enc l, enc (n * a)] ∧
        |t - rRatio a (n * a)| < epsIdx l := by
